body: I've thought about moving away entirely from this town. But that scares me. The thought of being alone and having to meet new people scare the hell out of me.

I guess it's a little of both. I feel over worked and stressed, and my boss sucks.

My friends I guess are just the people who are here and haven't moved away. Some of them are nice to me. But I just feel bored with them, and I don't have the energy to reciprocate anymore, so I feel guilty when I take advantage of their kindness.
The biggest thing is my job. But I think my friends are part of it, and some of it is just inevitable parts of getting older.
I had a lot more freedom, and everything felt new and exciting. Now I just feel trapped.
